pair.en: The six-month momentum of leading indicators has crossed the model's calibrated recession-risk threshold, but the share of indicators confirming weakness has not. Deterioration is concentrated rather than widespread. Both conditions are required before this model can flag recession risk.
pair.zh: 领先指标的六个月动量已越过模型校准的衰退风险阈值，但确认走弱的指标占比尚未达标。走弱集中，并未广泛扩散。这两项条件须同时满足，模型才会发出衰退风险信号。

pair.en: The share of leading indicators that are weakening has crossed the model's calibrated recession-risk threshold, but their six-month momentum has not. Weakness is widespread but shallow. Both conditions are required before this model can flag recession risk.
